sources.title: Muninn Mesh Server — Self-hosted governed memory for production AI
sources.snippet: Muninn Mesh Server Self-hosted governed memory for production AI Muninn Mesh Server carries accountable memory into production, inside your perimeter. A year of measured experiments in Muninn Mesh Lab produced the Mesh Memory Protocol; the server is its production implementation — small, fast, self-hosted, and uncomplicated to run.
